Why Buon Taco

Two traditions, one truck

Buon Taco is a one-of-a-kind food truck in Edwards, Colorado — authentic Mexican street tacos on one side of the menu, savory Italian pasta on the other, all made fresh every day from traditional family recipes.

Come for the al pastor off the spit, stay for the penne. Add sides of rice, beans, nopal and avocado, a cold Jarritos to drink, or carnitas by the pound to take home.
